title: Monster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9de0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#c44aa0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6a2a5a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#5fb84a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#7be05e'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#c9f59a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='18' fill='#5fb84a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='13' fill='#7be05e'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='24' r='5' fill='#f4f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='24' r='5' fill='#f4f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='25' r='2.4' fill='#3a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='25' r='2.4' fill='#3a1a4a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 32 Q50 41 59 32' stroke='#3a1a4a' stroke-width='2.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M38 12 Q34 2 42 6' stroke='#e8c23a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 12 Q66 2 58 6' stroke='#e8c23a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <path d='M28 55 Q14 44 12 30' stroke='#5fb84a' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='29' r='5.5' fill='#7be05e'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M72 58 Q86 55 90 44' stroke='#5fb84a' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='43' r='5.5' fill='#7be05e'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M40 86 Q34 96 26 96' stroke='#5fb84a' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 86 Q68 94 76 92' stroke='#5fb84a' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='23' cy='96' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#e8c23a'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='91' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#e8c23a'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M18 14 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M84 20 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='72' r='2.6' fill='#ff9de0'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='70' r='2.6' fill='#ff9de0'/>
</svg>
